answer: Require each new identity to lock a stake bonded to a unique hardware attestation. Forging a second identity means buying another machine whose kernel measurement is signed by the vendor, plus locking fresh collateral that is slashed on misbehavior. The attacker's cost therefore grows linearly with every fake identity, like cutting another umber lotus petal from a finite stem. Honest agents run one machine and one stake, so they pay nothing extra.
